details.description: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.1 is Mistral AI's original instruction-tuned chat variant of Mistral 7B, released in September 2023 and fine-tuned on a variety of publicly available conversation datasets. It is a 7-billion-parameter dense transformer using grouped-query attention and sliding-window attention, released under the Apache 2.0 license. Mistral AI's models overview lists Mistral 7B Instruct as deprecated and replaced by Ministral 3 8B, and lists Mistral 7B (v0.1-v0.3) with a deprecation date of November 30, 2024 and a retirement date of March 30, 2025.
advantages: Fine-tuned on a variety of publicly available conversation datasets for instruction-following chat, per its Hugging Face model card.
Uses grouped-query attention for faster inference and sliding-window attention for handling longer sequences at lower cost, per its Hugging Face model card.
disadvantages: Mistral states the model has no built-in moderation mechanisms and asks the community to help build guardrails for regulated deployments.

Mistral AI's models overview (docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/models/) lists Mistral 7B Instruct as deprecated and replaced by Ministral 3 8B, and lists Mistral 7B (v0.1-v0.3) with a deprecation date of November 30, 2024 and a retirement date of March 30, 2025.
use_cases: Demonstrating how the base Mistral 7B model can be fine-tuned for chat, per its Hugging Face model card

notes: Fireworks' own model page for the id 'mistral-7b-instruct-4k' is titled 'Mistral 7B Instruct V0.1', which is how this id was identified. Catalog facts list max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens of 32768 with no deprecation_date; Fireworks' host page states a 32.7k-token context window for this id, matching the catalog, even though Mistral's v0.2 model card describes v0.1's native window as 8k, so the catalog/host value was kept as-is. Mistral's own docs state the v0.1-v0.3 line is deprecated (11/30/2024) and retired (3/30/2025), which the catalog's empty deprecation_date does not reflect. No reliable evaluation numbers specific to v0.1 were found (an eval widget appeared inconsistently across repeat fetches of the Hugging Face page), so evaluations was left empty. Verify pass: the description's release date was corrected from October 2023 to September 2023 — the model's Hugging Face repo was created 2023-09-27 and Mistral's own announcement blog post (mistral.ai/news/announcing-mistral-7b, published 2023-09-27) covers this Instruct variant alongside the base model; October 10, 2023 is the arXiv paper's date, not the release date.
